problem: A newborn is drawn as a small child standing outside in the street.
want: Under age 3: an indoor scene, and a baby (in a cot or carried), not a walking figure.

problem: The scene does not follow the event: a night-time blackout or a shelter event plays over a daytime street in the rain.
want: The backdrop and light match where and when the open event happens, at least indoors/outdoors and day/night.

problem: On a phone the character card (name, age, health, money, month plan) sits below the log, a long scroll from the event.
want: The essentials and the month plan are reachable without scrolling past the log; nothing is hidden under the fixed tab bar.

problem: The result of the last choice appears as a line above the next event and is easy to miss; a new player cannot tell what their choice changed.
want: After a choice the player sees what happened and what changed (stat, money, mood), before or beside the next event.

problem: The start screen is one card of text; saved lives, the collection and how-to-play compete in the same block.
want: A first screen a new player understands in ten seconds: what the game is, one obvious way to begin, saved lives clearly apart.

problem: Six stats, two bars, money and the plan are shown from birth with no explanation of what any of them does.
want: A way to learn what each stat and bar means where it is shown (the glossary exists in Settings but nobody finds it there).

problem: Gates now pass a backdrop key (`s.op.def.place`: z_port, z_factory, z_bridge, z_campus, z_cliff, z_subway) to `setScene`. This was wired by the code agent and not looked at in a browser.
want: Each of the 8 gate themes shows its own backdrop; check all of them and fix what looks wrong.

problem: The me / world / collection tabs were not reviewed for a child or for a hunter.
want: Each tab reads clearly at every stage of life (spec §11.2–11.3); report what is confusing as new rows.
